 “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother” : Exclusive Interview with Actress Adia & Actor Abubakr Ali 
 by Nobuhiro Hosoki 
 © Courtesy of Amazon MGM Studios
 Watch this “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother” interview with Adia and Abubakr Ali to hear about their experiences working on the film set.
 In this conversation, we sit down with the actors to discuss the production process and the notes taken during shooting. The actors share their professional perspectives, providing context for the collaborative effort required to bring this story to the screen.
 Beyond their time on set, the actors discuss the upcoming release date for Your Mother, officially confirmed for September 25th in select theaters with a wide release in October. This discussion offers a firsthand look at the project for those interested in the craft of film acting.
 From writer-director Bassam Tariq, “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother” stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him — and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.
